categories.main_business_segments: Shaanxi Coal Industry Company Limited primarily engages in coal mining, coal washing, transportation, sales, and production services. The company also operates in coal chemical products, chemical fertilizers, fine chemical products, power production and supply, coal railway transportation, and new energy projects. It has multiple subsidiaries involved in coal mining, logistics, pipeline transportation, and clean energy development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes intelligent mining technologies, including smart mines and smart mining areas, with 95% of its production capacity being intelligent. It employs advanced coal mining techniques, digital transformation, industrial internet platforms, and automation systems. The company also focuses on clean energy technologies such as coalbed methane development and ecological restoration, and invests in R&D for intelligent mining equipment and environmental protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are in the power generation, chemical, and metallurgical industries. The company supplies coal products mainly for electricity, chemical, and steel sectors. It also serves domestic markets across various regions in China, with a focus on energy supply and coal distribution.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with coal mining assets concentrated in the Shaanxi province, particularly in the northern Shaanxi (Shanbei) mining area, Binhuang mining area, and Weibei mining area. It also has logistics and transportation operations within Shaanxi and neighboring regions. The company’s coal sales cover multiple regions including Northwest, Central China, South China, East China, Southwest, Northeast, and North China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shaanxi Coal Industry operates primarily in the upstream segment of the coal supply chain, focusing on coal extraction and processing. It also has midstream operations including coal transportation via rail and pipeline, and downstream sales and distribution services. The company integrates production, logistics, and sales to maintain control over the coal supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes high-quality development, intelligent mining, digital transformation, and green low-carbon initiatives aligned with China’s carbon neutrality goals. It invests heavily in R&D for intelligent mining systems, safety technologies, environmental protection, and new energy sectors. The company also pursues mergers and acquisitions to expand capacity and enhance competitiveness, while promoting innovation in smart mining and industrial internet platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of coal products, including raw coal and washed coal, as well as transportation services. The company also earns income from equity investments, financial investments, and government subsidies. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales contracts with industrial customers, and transportation fees are recognized upon service completion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shaanxi Coal Industry is a leading coal producer in China with significant resource advantages and large-scale production capacity. It ranks among the top in the coal mining industry in terms of production volume, intelligent mining capacity, and profitability. The company competes with other major Chinese coal producers such as Shenhua Group and China Coal Energy, positioning itself as a high-quality, technologically advanced, and environmentally responsible coal enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company achieved coal production of 157.3 million tons, a year-on-year increase of 11%. Operating revenue reached approximately 166.8 billion RMB, up 9.55%, with net profit attributable to shareholders of 35.12 billion RMB, a 63.98% increase. The company’s total assets were about 215.3 billion RMB, with steady growth in profitability and cash flow. It maintains strong financial health with a net asset return rate of 35.28%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its abundant high-quality coal resources, advanced intelligent mining technologies, and integrated supply chain capabilities. It differentiates itself through its commitment to safety, environmental sustainability, and digital transformation. Shaanxi Coal Industry offers reliable energy supply with competitive cost advantages and innovative smart mining solutions, positioning itself as a benchmark for high-quality and green development in the coal industry.
